headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona among clubs eyeing Man United's Ayden Heaven
description: Barcelona are interested in a loan move for Manchester United defender Ayden Heaven. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Viktor Gyökeres: Arsenal not wasting energy on Man City's possible sanctions
description: Viktor Gyökeres said Arsenal cannot afford to waste any energy on Manchester City's possible sanctions -- as he vowed to deliver back-to-back Premier League titles for the Gunners.

headline: VAR review: Why Man United should've gotten winner vs. Sporting
description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

headline: Man United's costly errors overshadow early progress under Mauricio Pochettino
description: Manchester United showed signs of progress under Mauricio Pochettino, but familiar mistakes cost them a Champions League win against Sporting CP.

headline: Andoni Iraola: Alexander Isak in a 'great moment' after brace vs. Club Brugge
description: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola believes striker Alexander Isak is in a "great moment" after he scored twice in the 3-0 victory over Club Brugge.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United, Barcelona eye USMNT's Mathis Albert
description: Both Manchester United and Barcelona are reportedly looking at signing Borussia Dortmund's Mathis Albert. Transfer Talk has the latest.
